name: Fast Voxel Traversal 2D
definition: Algorithm to traverse all 2D grid cells (voxels) that a line segment passes through, used for ray tracing acceleration and line-voxel intersection.
summary: Fast Voxel Traversal 2D is an algorithm that visits all 2D grid cells intersected by a line segment, unlike Bresenham's algorithm which omits cells for aesthetic reasons.
